description: Auto-generated derived type for NixBuilderJobsetSpec via `CustomResource`

attrPaths.description: Flake fragments `nix-eval-jobs` evaluates, one invocation per entry. Must list at least one -- an empty list would mean nothing is ever evaluated for this project.

client.description: Name of the NixBuilderClient this project's builds are attributed to (quota, pool routing). Not validated against a real NixBuilderClient existing -- matches NixBuilderPool.spec.clients' existing precedent.

flakeRef.description: Repo-level flake identity, e.g. "github:krezh/dotnix" -- no ref/query fragment. Jobsets (one per branch/PR) are still created dynamically underneath this project when a webhook reports a ref of this repo.

pools.description: Advisory list of pool names this project is expected to build on. Checked at reconcile time (logged, not enforced) against each named pool's own `clients` list.
